title: RowResponse
description: Response body (200) for a successful PATCH /api/data-sources/:id/rows/:rowId (HEL-1078 design.md D8) -- the edited row plus the source-level `updatedAt`. DELETE returns 204 with no body and has no corresponding schema. `deniedPipelines` (HEL-1096) lists every downstream pipeline this patch denied auto-run for that the writer has visibility into -- empty when nothing was denied.
